astrum.configuration.title: Astrum settings
astrum.configuration.section.astrum.serv: Server settings (single-player: applies immediately; a hand-edited file needs the next world entry)
Astrum server settings (single-player: applies immediately; a hand-edited file needs the next world entry)
astrum.card.already_owned: %s is already in your book - the card was not used.
astrum.card.quarantined: Your character book cannot be read (an unreadable save is kept on disk) - the card was not used.
astrum.card.no_character: This card names no character, so it grants nothing.
astrum.card.unknown_character: No character %s is defined by the loaded pack - the card grants nothing.
astrum.card.no_registry: No character data is loaded (open a world first) - the card was not used.
astrum.command.help.header: Astrum debug commands (permission level 2). Slots are numbered 1-5 on the command line; the party and the wheel number them 0-4 internally.
astrum.command.help.roster: /astrum roster - owned characters with level, exp and affection
astrum.command.help.party: /astrum party set <slot 1-5> <characterId> | party clear <slot 1-5> | party list
astrum.command.help.cast: /astrum cast <slot 1-5> - fires that slot, with exactly the validation the cast key uses
astrum.command.help.affection: /astrum affection add <n> [characterId] - clamped at the tier-3 threshold (default: the selected slot)
astrum.command.help.tune: /astrum tune areaCharge [pairCooldownTicks <n> | receiveCapPerSecond <v>] | tune reset - operator tuning for the area_charge guards
astrum.command.no_player: This command needs a player: it reads and writes player data.
astrum.command.no_registry: No character data is loaded right now (is a world open?).
astrum.command.unknown_character: No character %s is defined by the loaded pack.
astrum.command.bad_slot: Slot %1$s is out of range: commands number the five slots 1-%2$s (internally 0-4).
astrum.command.book_quarantined: Your character book cannot be read (an unreadable save is kept on disk); nothing was changed.
astrum.command.roster.empty: The character book is empty - right-click a character card to enrol one.
astrum.command.party.moved: Slot %1$s now holds %2$s (moved out of slot %3$s).
astrum.command.party.not_owned: %s is not in your character book - enrol it with a card first.
astrum.command.charge.range: Charge must be between %2$s and %3$s, got %1$s.
astrum.cast.reason.SLOT_OUT_OF_RANGE: that slot does not exist on the wheel
astrum.cast.reason.CHARACTER_UNKNOWN: that slot names a character the pack no longer defines
astrum.cast.reason.COOLDOWN: the global cooldown has not ended
astrum.command.affection.not_owned: %s is not in your character book.
astrum.command.affection.no_default: No character named, and the selected wheel slot is empty.
astrum.command.tune.reset: area_charge overrides cleared - both guards read the server config again.
